Misiorowski makes World Series history as Brewers take Game 1!
Jacob Misiorowski unleashed a record-breaking 103.5 mph pitch to become the fastest pitcher in World Series history! Milwaukee edged the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in the opener, with Christian Yelich playing a key role as the Brewers took a 1-0 lead in the Fall Classic!
